update directory_nodes
parent_id = #{parentId},
label = #{label}, x = #{x}, y = #{y}
where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted_at is null

with recursive subtree (id) as ( select id from directory_nodes where user_id = #{userId} and deleted_at is null and id in
#{id}
union distinct
select child.id from directory_nodes child join subtree parent on child.parent_id = parent.id where child.user_id = #{userId} ) update directory_nodes node join subtree on subtree.id = node.id set node.deleted_at = current_timestamp(6) where node.deleted_at is null
